test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A tank has two inlets, I₁ and I₂. I1 alone can fill it in 8 hours, and I₂ alone can fill it in 4 hours. If both inlets are open, how long will it take to fill the tank?
solution:
**Given:**

I1 fills tank in 8 hours

I2 fills tank in 4 hours

**Formula used:**

LCM of time = Total work

Work rate = Total work ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

LCM of 8 and 4 = 8 (Total work)

I1 rate ⇒ 8 ÷ 8 = 1 unit/hour

I2 rate ⇒ 8 ÷ 4 = 2 units/hour

Total rate ⇒ 1 + 2 = 3 units/hour

Time ⇒ 8 ÷ 3 = 2(2)/(3) hours

**∴ Time = 2(2)/(3) hours**
